open: No 7-Eleven or staffed ticket office (DSB lists none; 7-Eleven list has no Middelfart store).
Toilets: DSB says locked because of vandalism; OSM hours are probably stale.
OSM extract has no platform ways; lifts are not linked to perron 1 (spor 1/3) or 2 (spor 4). Whether the lifts reach the platforms or the street on the far side is unsettled.
Shops (City Kiosk, KudosGames Café, Bennike el) are 'in station building' per OSM only; their own sites not checked.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.
